name: ChatGPT
desc_zh: OpenAI 的通用对话助手，写东西、查资料、出主意都在这儿。
solves: One chat box that drafts, rewrites, translates, and takes follow-ups without you switching tools mid-sentence.
solves_zh: 一个对话框里起草、改写、翻译、接着追问，中途不用切走。
best_for: Drafting, translating, or untangling a piece of writing before anyone else sees it.
best_for_zh: 要起草、翻译，或者把写好的一整段文字理顺再发出去的时候。
